units.source_text: 从内地各处来此烧香的乡下人甚多。

en.t: Many country people had come from all parts of the provinces to burn incense here.

units.source_text: 大和国的国守夫人也来烧香，仆从如云，威势显赫。

en.t: The wife of the governor of Yamato Province also came to burn incense, attended by a cloud of servants and displaying impressive splendor.

units.source_text: 三条看了不胜艳羡，便合掌以手加额，虔诚祷告：

en.t: Sanjo saw this and was overcome with envy, so she pressed her palms together, raised her hands to her forehead, and prayed devoutly:
Homage to the greatly merciful and compassionate Bodhisattva Kannon!

units.source_text: 小人三条别无祈愿，但望菩萨保佑我家小姐，

en.t: I, humble Sanjo, have no other wish; I only ask the Bodhisattva to protect my young lady,

units.source_text: 让她做个大弍夫人，不然，做个国守夫人。

en.t: and let her become the wife of a Daini, or if not, the wife of a provincial governor.

units.source_text: 让我三条也享荣华富贵。

en.t: Let me, Sanjo, enjoy glory, wealth, and rank as well.

units.source_text: 那时我等定当前来隆重还愿！”

en.t: When that time comes, we will surely return and make a grand offering of thanks!

units.source_text: 右近听见了，心念这祈愿太不吉利，太没志气了。

en.t: Ukon heard this and thought that the prayer was terribly inauspicious and far too lacking in ambition.

units.source_text: 便对三条说道：“你真正变成乡下人了！

en.t: So she said to Sanjo, You really have turned into a country woman!

units.source_text: 小姐的父亲从前还是个头中将，也已经威势鼎盛了。

en.t: Even when our young lady's father was still only Captain Secretary, his power and prestige were already at their height.

units.source_text: 何况现在当了独揽天下政权的内大臣，何等尊荣高贵！

en.t: Now that he is the Minister of the Center, holding the government of the realm in his own hands, how honored and exalted he is!

units.source_text: 难道你要品定他家小姐当个地方官太太不成？”

en.t: Do you really mean to rate a daughter of his house as no more than the wife of a provincial official?

units.source_text: 三条愤然答道：“算了，不要噜苏了！

en.t: Sanjo answered indignantly, Enough, stop going on and on!

units.source_text: 开口大臣，闭口大臣，大臣值得什么呢！

en.t: Minister this, minister that, what is so special about a minister?

units.source_text: 你不曾看见大弍夫人在清水观世音寺进香时的威风哩，不亚于皇帝行幸呢！

en.t: You never saw the magnificence of the Daini's wife when she came to offer incense at Kiyomizu Kannon Temple; it was no less splendid than an imperial procession!
What you are saying is utterly ridiculous!

units.source_text: 便更加虔诚地拜个不住。

en.t: Then she went on bowing even more devoutly, without stopping.
